environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster (v1.28) with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled on all namespaces. PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS cluster-wide. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the user-service workload in 'backend' namespace. The policy uses a combination of 'from' source principals and 'to' operation paths. Specifically, the policy has a DENY action for requests to paths prefixed with '/internal/' where the source principal does NOT match 'cluster.local/ns/backend/sa/admin-service'. However, the policy is defined with a 'rules' block using notPrincipals rather than an explicit ALLOW, and the mesh-wide policy is set to ALLOW by default with this single targeted DENY rule. The Envoy sidecar enforces this at L7 before traffic reaches the application container on port 8080.
